summary: Delete Record: permanently removes one record from the cloud database by id when its store signal fires.
description: Delete Record removes the record identified by `modelId` (or, per `idSource`, the enclosing repeater item) from its class when `store` fires. `deleted` confirms; `failure`/`error` carry access-control or missing-record problems. Query Records nodes observing the class see the record leave their results automatically.
whenToUse: Destructive removal of cloud records. If the product needs undo or soft delete, model an 'archived' flag with Set Record Properties instead — deletion is final.

ports.modelId: Id of the record to delete.

runtimeBehavior: Class choice and id sourcing are schema/editor-driven (declared-port-groups + runtime-discovered); the port set follows the configured class, and `idSource` can bind the id to the enclosing repeater item instead of the input.
antiPatterns: Wiring a click straight to `store` with no confirmation step for user-facing deletes.
